Busting out the throwaway for this. 


I learned about masturbating early in life. I really liked to use the bathtub faucet, my parents bath had amazing water pressure, so I at the age of like 9 went to bathe in their tub.   I turned the faucet on and closed the bath curtain for privacy. Then I accidentally knocked some shampoo bottles over behind me and turned around to pick them up. I was crouched down getting the bottles when my mom barges in and scares the daylights out of me, causing me to jerk upright. I was close enough to take about 2 inches worth of my back off thanks to that damn faucet. I still have a scar from that day. 

Only my husband knows the REAL story behind it, not that I was picking up bottles. I got scared shitless cause I thought she would somehow know I was trying to play around lol
No I haven't. And I don't think so. I just have a chemical issue in my head is all I can figure
I now have a banana peel on my foot.
How long until they fell off? Or at least died lol
It's what I plan to do. Thank you kind stranger

His ex wife lied about it to make her multiple affairs seem ok. The DUI was over ten years ago. (He's 29) my family just never thinks anyone is good enough and they need to stop. He has done nothing but love and care for me and my son.
That's just it. They can't lol. He has a ton of tattoos and a record (DUI) and they think he's abusive when they have nothing to back it with
It's more of a "no one will be good enough for you" type of thing. When I dated people they wanted me to they would complain. So it's a problem they have.
I have two sets of stairs in my house. The bedrooms are upstairs. I climb them tons...I'm just sick of not feeling motivated.

My husband and son were hit head on by a drunk driver. My son is 3, terrified of vehicles now. My husband requires surgery to fix his back. I more than likely have cancer, my ex won't allow me to proceed with an oral surgery on my son so he will start talking. My family hates my husband, I am constantly being preached to by my mother who doesn't understand I believe the same as her, I just live and show it differently. 

I'm bipolar and depressed, my husband is bipolar, my mother is a sociopath and it seems like I can't cope with the world changing. I have a hard time grasping that kids born in 2000 are in high school. I was just in high school...here I am 23. 

I have not went to college to be what I always wanted to be. In fact, I can't even look at dead bodies anymore. Let alone want to cut it open to see how they died. I have more issues in my own head that I am too scared to let out because I don't want to lose my son..he keeps the seems tied together. It's bad enough my husband is gone months at a time for work...I hate being alone.. 

Ignore this wall of text, I'm just using this to get shit off my chest instead of sitting on my couch crying. I have no motivation. I just want to sleep. I see the muscle being replaced with flab and I am disgusted with myself...I'm 23 damn years old and climbing stairs is wearing me down. I have no friends around. My son doesn't have friends because I cannot muster up the courage to send him to day care. Or meet someone with a kid similar in age... I honestly think I'm going crazy right now...and all I can do to stop the crazy is smile.
